reports.title: Fasting Blood Glucose & HbA1c Diagnostic Report
reports.notes: Patient presented with mild fatigue and polydipsia. Routine glycemic profile evaluation.
reports.clinicalImpression: Indicative of early Stage-2 Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus with elevated glycemic variability. Advised strict glycemic control, lifestyle modification, and endocrinology follow-up in 90 days.
reports.prescription: Tab. Metformin 500mg BD after meals; 45 mins brisk walking daily.

keyFindings: Fasting Blood Sugar: 142 mg/dL (Elevated, Diabetic baseline)
Postprandial Glucose: 198 mg/dL (Exceeds 140 mg/dL normal threshold)
HbA1c: 7.4% (Consistent with early Stage-2 Type 2 Diabetes)
abnormalFlags: Elevated Fasting Glucose (142 mg/dL) vs Normal (70-99 mg/dL)
aiHighlights.diagnosticImpression: Confirmed Stage-2 Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus with moderate glycemic variability.
aiHighlights.recommendedAction: Initiate metformin oral therapy; follow up in 90 days with repeat HbA1c.

reports.notes: Complaints of chronic lower back pain following occupational heavy lifting.
reports.clinicalImpression: No acute cortical fracture or vertebral dislocation identified. Mild lumbar spondylosis with degenerative disc space narrowing at L4-L5 and L5-S1 interspaces.
reports.prescription: Core lumbar stabilization physiotherapy; ergonomically contoured lumbar support belt.

keyFindings: Vertebral Cortices: Intact (Acute traumatic fracture excluded)
Disc Spaces: Degenerative narrowing at L4-L5 and L5-S1 levels
Osteophytes: Early anterior lumbar marginal spurring
abnormalFlags: Degenerative lumbar disc space narrowing at L4-L5 and L5-S1
No acute traumatic cortical discontinuity identified
aiHighlights.diagnosticImpression: Mild lumbar spondylosis with multilevel degenerative disc arthropathy; no fracture.
aiHighlights.recommendedAction: Engage in core-strengthening physical therapy; ergonomic work posture modification.

reports.prescription: Tab. Aspirin 75mg OD; Tab. Atorvastatin 20mg HS; Urgent Stress Echocardiogram.

keyFindings: Cardiac Biomarker hs-cTnI: 0.008 ng/mL (Myocardial necrosis ruled out)
12-Lead Rhythm: Regular Sinus Rhythm at 96 bpm
Enzyme Marker CK-MB: 18.4 U/L (Optimal physiological baseline)
abnormalFlags: No critical ischemic ST elevation or myocardial infarction markers identified
aiHighlights.diagnosticImpression: Atypical chest discomfort with negative cardiac biomarkers; acute ischemia ruled out.
aiHighlights.recommendedAction: Schedule outpatient stress echocardiography to assess inducible ischemia.

reports.title: High-Resolution Pulmonary Spirometry & Lung Function Test
reports.notes: Complaints of recurrent dry cough, expiratory wheezing triggered by dust and cold air.
reports.clinicalImpression: Spirometry reveals mild reversible obstructive airway pattern with 15% post-bronchodilator FEV1 improvement. Findings diagnostic of mild bronchial asthma.
reports.prescription: Inhaler Budesonide + Formoterol 200/6 mcg 1 puff BD; SOS Levosalbutamol inhaler.

keyFindings: FEV1/FVC Ratio: 68.4% (Obstructive ventilatory defect)
Post-Bronchodilator FEV1 Reversibility: +15% (Significant bronchodilation)
Forced Vital Capacity (FVC): 3.15 L (Normal lung volumes)
abnormalFlags: Reversible obstructive airflow limitation consistent with bronchial asthma
aiHighlights.diagnosticImpression: Mild persistent bronchial asthma responsive to inhaled bronchodilators.
aiHighlights.recommendedAction: Commence maintenance ICS-LABA combination therapy; repeat spirometry in 60 days.
